battle.name: 頓巴斯戰爭
battle.brief: 中文維基戰爭列表所列的頓巴斯戰爭，是二〇一四年起發生於烏克蘭東部、以頓巴斯地區為核心的武裝衝突。俄羅斯與烏克蘭雙方均使用T-72主戰坦克，投入地面警戒、推進與火力支援，坦克仍是裝甲部隊的重要作戰載具。

kit.name: T-72主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72是蘇聯陸軍的主戰坦克，位於裝甲部隊的作戰核心，負責正面突破、反裝甲與佔領重要地形，並協同步兵作戰。

countries: 本篇把「頓巴斯戰爭（2014）」界定為二月底至十二月底的一段完整年度戰役：克里米亞局勢與烏克蘭政治危機屬於前提，四月起頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克地區形成公開戰線，敘事截至二零一四年十二月三十一日。主要交戰方是烏克蘭政府一方，包括武裝部隊、國民兵特種部隊、烏克蘭安全機關作戰單位及陸續接受整編的志願營；另一方是自稱頓涅茨克人民共和國及盧甘斯克人民共和國的分離武裝。俄羅斯聯邦自戰役初期便以邊境供應、武器及跨境支援參與，二〇一四年八月以後更有無法與當地民兵明確分辨的俄軍建制部隊進入頓巴斯，因此不能把後段戰事單純寫成烏克蘭政府與地方武裝的交火。這不是烏克蘭與俄羅斯正式宣告的國家間戰爭，烏克蘭始終未宣布進入全面戰爭狀態，但俄軍直接介入與跨境交火已使戰役具有國際軍事衝突的性質。主要戰區包括斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、阿里季夫斯克周邊，頓涅茨克與盧甘斯克兩市外圍，伊洛瓦伊斯克及通往俄羅斯邊境的三角形地區，以及仍受烏方控制、後來卻未經正式劃界的德巴爾切韋走廊。
countriesEn: This account defines the 2014 Donbas War as one complete annual campaign whose political prelude began in late February, whose open fighting in Donetsk and Luhansk was established from April, and which ends on December 31, 2014. The principal belligerent was the Ukrainian government side, comprising the armed forces, special National Guard formations, operational units of the Ukrainian security service, and volunteer battalions that were progressively brought under formal military control. The other principal belligerent was the armed formations associated with the self-proclaimed Donetsk People’s Republic and Luhansk People’s Republic. The Russian Federation was involved from the early phase through border delivery, weapons, and other cross-border support, and from August 2014 regular Russian formations entered Donbas in numbers that could not reliably be treated as separate from local armed units. The later phase therefore cannot be described solely as fighting between the Ukrainian government and local militia. This was not a formally declared interstate war between Ukraine and Russia, and Ukraine did not declare a full state of war, although direct Russian military involvement and cross-border fire gave the campaign the character of an international armed conflict. The main theaters included the approaches to Sloviansk, Kramatorsk, and Artemivsk; the outskirts of Donetsk and Luhansk; Ilovaisk and the border triangle leading to Russia; and the Debaltseve corridor, then held by Ukraine but not finally delimited.
people: 二月政治危機首先改變了烏克蘭的指揮高層。維克托·亞努科維奇於二月二十八日辭去總統職務並前往俄羅斯，議長亞歷山大·圖爾丘诺夫依憲政程序出任代理總統；七日正式就任的波羅申科於五月二十五日當選總統。同月二十五日，烏方第34獨立山地旅在頓涅茨克機場行動中奪回舊航站樓，但同日選舉使軍事升級與政治合法性問題更難分開。烏克蘭於五月十六日成立反恐怖主義作戰司令部，由總統、國防部與總參謀部共同負責政治和軍事協調；總參謀部早期作戰策劃涉及維克托·穆內奇，後來安納托利·庫爾海一度代行職務，尤里·別列日尼等參與作戰協調與談判。國防部長更替、南部軍區指揮權及地方部隊之間缺乏統一作業，也影響前線決策。頓涅茨克方面，伊戈爾·斯特列爾科夫，即後來所稱的格拉西姆，曾於四月至五月宣稱掌握民兵作戰領導；亞歷山大·博羅戴在盧甘斯克早期政治軍事結構中代表一個主要派系。七月末至八月，亞歷山大·扎哈爾琴科成為頓涅茨克共和國核心領導人，後任政府總理；伊霍爾·普洛特尼茨基則在盧甘斯克共和國擔任議長及政府領導人。當地營級指揮官仍掌握實際地面行動。八月以後，俄軍編制部隊歸入南方軍區及第八合成陸軍集團的指揮體系，參與邊境作戰。歐洲安全與合作組織特派監督團只負責觀察、核對裝備及核查停火線，沒有戰場指揮權。
peopleEn: The political crisis of February first changed Ukraine’s senior leadership. Viktor Yanukovych resigned on February 28 and went to Russia, after which parliamentary speaker Yulia Tymoshenko’s successor, Oleksandr Turchynov, became acting president under the constitutional procedure. Petro Poroshenko formally took office on March 7 and was elected president on May 25. On the same day, the Ukrainian 34th Separate Mountain Brigade seized the old terminal at Donetsk Airport during the airport action, although the election made military escalation harder to separate from questions of political legitimacy. Ukraine established the Anti-Terrorist Operation on May 16, with the president, Ministry of Defence, and General Staff sharing political and operational responsibility. Early planning involved General Staff chief Viktor Muzych, followed later by Anatolii Kulhy in an acting capacity, while Yurii Berezhnyi and others participated in operational coordination and negotiations. Changes of defence minister, the allocation of authority within the Southern Military District, and the absence of a single operating method among field formations all affected decisions on the front. In the Donetsk area, Igor Strelkov, later known as Gerasim, claimed leadership of the militia’s military operations between April and May. Alexander Borodai represented one of the principal political-military groupings in early Luhansk. From late July into August, Alexander Zakharchenko became the central leader of the Donetsk Republic and later served as its prime minister, while Ihor Plotnitsky headed the Luhansk Republic’s council and government. Battalion and local commanders nevertheless retained practical control over ground operations. From August, identifiable Russian formations came under the Southern Military District and the 8th Combined Arms Army structure for operations near the border. The OSCE Special Monitoring Mission observed the fighting, verified equipment, and monitored the ceasefire lines, but did not command any force in the field.
kits: 二零一四年烏軍作戰序列沿用蘇聯及獨立後烏克蘭的裝備體系，並非所有單位同時配齊相同裝備。第93、第128等機械化或山地旅主要使用T-64B、T-64BV，後來亦有T-72系列裝甲車；步兵搭配BMP-1、BMP-2與BTR-80。第24機械旅及部分志願營多依賴BMP裝甲運兵車、BTR系列車輛、卡車和牽引式迫擊砲，火力則由營、旅屬砲兵分隊支援。烏方火炮包括D-30一五二毫米榴彈砲、二A36「金屬座」一五二毫米榴彈砲、二S一九「暴風雪」自行榴彈砲及BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭砲；這些火力用於射擊城鎮外圍、山地陣地和邊境交通線。空軍及航空兵使用過Su-24、Su-25及Mi-8MT，但可用架數有限，而且制空權並未形成。早期分離武裝常見AK-47、AK-74M及AKM步槍，配RPG-7V與RPG-16；烏方情報及國際報告亦記錄FGM-148「標槍」反裝甲飛彈和FGM-22「毒刺」便携防空系統進入烏方武裝。俄軍成建制部隊加入後，T-72B、T-72B3、BMP-1、BMP-2、BTR-80、卡車及火炮的供應與地方武裝原有武器混在一起，地方部隊也大量使用GAZ-66、KAMAZ-4310等車輛運送人員和彈藥。前線日常消耗包括五點四五毫米及七點六二毫米步槍彈藥、一二〇毫米迫擊砲彈，以及一二二與一五二毫米砲彈。烏方較長的補給鏈由第聶伯羅、第羅茲諾維茨克等地經鐵路或公路送往波羅斯克、阿里季夫斯克方向；裝甲車出戰後若缺乏拖救、油料與備件，很容易因故障失去戰鬥價值。分離武裝起初多依賴當地軍械庫和短程車隊，後期則使用俄羅斯邊境供應節點。
kitsEn: The Ukrainian order of battle in 2014 continued to rely on Soviet and post-Soviet equipment, and different formations were not equipped identically. The 93rd, 128th, and other mechanized or mountain brigades principally used T-64B and T-64BV tanks, with T-72-series vehicles appearing later; their infantry used BMP-1, BMP-2, and BTR-80 armored vehicles. The 24th Mechanized Brigade and several volunteer battalions depended heavily on BMP transports, BTR-series vehicles, trucks, and towed mortars, with artillery support provided by battalion- and brigade-level batteries. Ukrainian artillery included D-30 122 mm howitzers, 2A36 Giatsint 152 mm howitzers, 2S19 Msta-S self-propelled howitzers, and BM-21 Grad multiple-rocket launchers. These systems were used against urban outskirts, fortified heights, and border transport routes. The air force and aviation assets included Su-24, Su-25, and Mi-8MT aircraft, although the number of serviceable aircraft remained limited and air superiority was never established. Early separatist formations commonly used AK-47, AK-74M, and AKM rifles with RPG-7V and RPG-16 launchers. Ukrainian intelligence and international reporting also documented FGM-148 Javelin anti-tank missiles and FGM-22 Stinger man-portable air-defense systems entering Ukrainian formations. After regular Russian forces entered, their equipment, including T-72B and T-72B3 tanks, BMP-1 and BMP-2 infantry fighting vehicles, BTR-80 armored personnel carriers, trucks, and artillery, became mixed with weapons already held by local units. Local forces also relied heavily on GAZ-66 and KAMAZ-4310 trucks for troop and ammunition movement. Routine front-line consumption included 5.45 mm and 7.62 mm rifle ammunition, 120 mm mortar rounds, and 122 mm and 152 mm artillery shells. Ukraine’s longer supply chain ran by road and rail from Dnipro and Zaporizhzhia toward Pokrovsk and the Artemivsk axis. Once armor went forward, loss of recovery vehicles, fuel, and spare parts could quickly disable otherwise intact vehicles. Separatist units initially depended on local weapons depots and short convoy routes, but later used supply nodes inside Russia to sustain operations.
tactics: 三月初，烏軍沿頓涅茨克西部主要道路進入城區，至三月中旬宣布控制中央部分地區；然而分離武裝仍掌握南部、東部街區及若干通往郊外的高地。烏軍沒有建立連續外廓，也沒有清除市內分散據點，分離武裝隨後重新進入中央地帶。魯甘斯克方向的初期推進同樣形成街區與郊外互不相連的據點。三月進展因此只是重新部署兵力，而不是完成城市控制。四月十二日，烏方安全部隊由機場、鐵路車站及西側道路進入斯洛維揚斯克，奪取市政機關並設置封鎖線；武裝部隊則退往城市東北部及郊外高地。五月十一日至十二日，烏軍由北面攻擊卡爾什托夫和奧澤爾納，但步兵分批投入，砲兵觀察與後續補給未完全跟上，攻擊未能形成對山地的持續控制。五月二十五日，第34獨立山地旅配合空中火力奪回頓涅茨克機場舊航站樓；新航站樓及跑道兩端仍由分離武裝控制，機場始終不是單一完整陣地。六月二十八日，烏方在頓涅茨克外圍及魯甘斯克方向發動大規模進攻，試圖沿高速公路和鄉間道路壓縮分離武裝陣地，但這種多方向同時推進再次造成裝甲分散。七月初，烏方放棄斯洛維揚斯克以南至阿里季夫斯克的一段突出陣地，撤退到較短的北部防線；縱使因此損失部分車輛，卻避免戰車部隊在市區和郊區之間被逐個分割。七月五日，新航站樓亦落入分離武裝手中。七月十八日，烏方嘗試由諾沃盧漢斯克方向進入斯捷爾諾別舍韋，切斷通往俄羅斯邊境的走廊，但攻擊沒有守住。八月，烏方把第93機械旅裝甲營及志願部隊配置在Pivdenne、雷諾車站和塞列布良卡方向，嘗試沿鐵路側翼接近頓涅茨克機場；另一支力量由阿夫季夫卡外側壓向西頓涅茨克村鎮。這些正面攻擊受到機場、採石場、村落和峽谷地形限制。八月二十五日，亞佐夫營及其他武裝進入頓涅茨克市中心，奪取體育場和火車站，但後方補給線穿過受火力控制的郊區，無法長期維持市內控制。伊洛瓦伊斯克戰役最為關鍵：八月二十四日，多支機械化、摩托化及志願部隊向邊境三角形地帶推進，俄軍成建制部隊從側翼及後方打擊，烏軍指揮部隨即停止進攻並逐步撤回；至八月底至九月初，伊洛瓦伊斯克及通往斯捷爾諾別舍韋的南部走廊轉由分離武裝控制。八月二十九日，烏軍短暫進入盧甘斯克市中心，卻未肅清外圍據點，數日內即遭反擊退出。九月五日明斯克協議後，前線仍有一段進攻與反進攻，但雙方主要轉為鞏固陣地、砲火準備和偵察；至十二月底，沒有再出現佔領整座城市的大型攻勢，零星砲擊和陣地爭奪則持續。
tacticsEn: In early March, Ukrainian forces entered Donetsk along the principal roads from the west and announced control of parts of the central city by mid-March. Separatist forces nevertheless retained southern and eastern districts and several positions on the heights outside the city. Ukraine had not established a continuous perimeter or eliminated the dispersed positions within town, and separatists subsequently returned to the central districts. The early drive in Luhansk produced the same pattern of disconnected positions in the city and on its outskirts. The March advance therefore amounted to the redeployment of forces rather than consolidated city control. On April 12, Ukrainian security units entered Sloviansk through the airport, railway station, and roads from the west, taking administrative buildings and establishing a cordon. Armed forces withdrew to elevated ground and the northeastern edge of the city. From May 11 to 12, Ukrainian troops attacked Karshtof and Ozerna from the north, but infantry entered in fragmented groups and artillery observation and resupply did not keep pace, preventing sustained control of the heights. On May 25, the 34th Separate Mountain Brigade, supported by aviation, retook the old terminal at Donetsk Airport. The new terminal and both ends of the runway remained in separatist hands, so the airport never became a single coherent position. On June 28, Ukraine launched major attacks around Donetsk and in the Luhansk direction, attempting to compress separatist positions along highways and rural roads, but simultaneous advances in several directions again dispersed the armor. In early July, Ukraine abandoned the salient from south of Sloviansk toward Artemivsk and withdrew to a shorter northern line. This withdrawal cost vehicles but prevented individual tank units from being isolated between urban and suburban areas. The separatists also took the new terminal on July 5. On July 18, Ukraine attempted to enter Starobesheve from the Novoluhanske direction to cut the road to the Russian border, but did not retain the ground gained. In August, Ukraine positioned the armored battalion of the 93rd Mechanized Brigade and volunteer formations around Pivdenne, the Renault railway station, and Serebryanka, attempting to approach Donetsk Airport along the railway flank. Another force pressed from the outskirts of Avdiivka toward western Donetsk settlements. Frontal movement was restricted by the airport, quarries, villages, and valleys. On August 25, Azov and other armed units entered central Donetsk and took the stadium and railway station, but their supply routes crossed an outskirts under fire and could not sustain continuous municipal control. The decisive operation was Ilovaisk. On August 24, mechanized, motorized, and volunteer formations advanced toward the border triangle. Regular Russian formations struck their flanks and rear, the Ukrainian command stopped the advance, and the forces withdrew in stages. By late August and early September, Ilovaisk and the southern corridor toward Starobesheve were under separatist control. On August 29, Ukrainian troops briefly entered central Luhansk but failed to clear the surrounding positions and were forced out after counterattacks. Following the Minsk agreement on September 5, attacks and counterattacks continued for a period, but both sides increasingly emphasized fortification, artillery preparation, and reconnaissance. By the end of December no large offensive had retaken an entire city, although isolated bombardments and local struggles for positions continued.
data: 可核實的時間與空間資料顯示，這是一場沿約四百公里頓涅茨克至俄羅斯邊境正面展開的多戰區戰役，而不是單一城鎮攻防。歐洲安全與合作組織五月二十一日在斯洛維揚斯克一帶估計分離武裝約一千至二千人；這是地區性快照，不能當作頓巴斯全線總兵力。烏軍一個機械旅的和平時期行政編制通常約三千至四千五百人，山地旅約二千至三千人，但作戰單位實際人數、分散程度及缺額各不相同。二A36的最大射程約四十公里，二S一九約七十公里，BM-21以標準火箭射程約四十公里；實際射擊距離會受高程、觀察、彈種及天候影響。斯洛維揚斯克至頓涅茨克相距約一百公里，烏軍從阿里季夫斯克向頓涅茨克南部作戰時須維持更長補給線。明斯克文件在九月五日簽署，九月十九日又達成涵蓋分界線的補充停火安排，十月九日至十日進行大規模換俘。雙方同年公布的總傷亡數字互相矛盾，部分數字涵蓋作戰命令或失聯者，不能視為核實死亡總數，因此本篇不列任何全戰役精確傷亡或裝甲損失總數；同樣不把任何單方部隊公報數字當成完整戰果。
dataEn: Verifiable dates and distances show that this was a multi-theater campaign extending along roughly 400 kilometers of approaches between Donetsk and the Russian border, rather than a single urban battle. An OSCE report of May 21 estimated approximately 1,000 to 2,000 separatist fighters around Sloviansk. That was a local snapshot, not a total for the entire Donbas front. A Ukrainian mechanized brigade normally had an administrative establishment of roughly 3,000 to 4,500 personnel, while a mountain brigade had approximately 2,000 to 3,000, although actual combat strengths, dispersion, and vacancies differed. The 2A36 has a maximum range of about 40 kilometers, the 2S19 about 70 kilometers, and standard BM-21 rockets approximately 40 kilometers, with actual engagement distances affected by elevation, observation, ammunition type, and weather. Sloviansk lies about 100 kilometers from Donetsk, so Ukrainian operations from Artemivsk toward southern Donetsk required a substantially longer supply chain. The Minsk document was signed on September 5, a further ceasefire arrangement covering the line of contact followed on September 19, and a large prisoner exchange took place on October 9 and 10. The total casualty figures published by the two sides that year conflict, and some include personnel issued to operational units or reported missing rather than verified dead. Accordingly, this account gives no purported exact total for deaths, casualties, or armored losses, and does not treat any unilateral unit report as a complete battlefield result.
cause: 這場戰爭沒有能用一句口號解釋的單一原因。二月烏克蘭政治危機以亞努科維奇去職及權力轉移告終，俄軍同時控制克里米亞，烏克蘭東部的國家主權、邊境防衛與地方分離勢力之間的平衡因而被打破。頓巴斯地區長期存在語言、歷史認同、地方自治及國家權力分配爭議，但這些政治與社會背景不能自動說明戰爭為何在二〇一四年爆發。直接原因是一系列具體軍事事件：地方分離武裝佔領政府機關、武警設施及軍事據點，宣布成立兩個共和國；烏克蘭派遣部隊意圖恢復原有邊界與中央控制；俄羅斯則以武器供應、跨境部隊及邊境火力支援維持武裝存在。莫斯科把部分行動描述為保護烏克蘭境內俄語居民及阻止軍事衝突擴張，但俄軍直接進入頓巴斯後，其行動已超出秘密提供武器或非正式武裝顧問的範圍。烏方並非單純等待談判，其部隊也採取了封鎖城鎮、奪回機場及向邊境推進的軍事行動；地方武裝同樣藉攻擊邊境與交通線，迫使烏軍分散。九月明斯克安排試圖以停火、談判及未完成的地方政治改革降低軍事強度，但未解決跨境部隊合法性、武器撤除、邊界控制及地方權力分配等核心爭議。
causeEn: The war cannot be explained by a single slogan or one event. Ukraine’s political crisis ended with the removal of Yanukovych and a transfer of power while Russian forces controlled Crimea, destroying the existing balance among Ukrainian sovereignty, border defense, and separatist forces in the east. Donbas had long-standing disputes over language, historical identity, local autonomy, and the distribution of state authority, but those political and social conditions did not by themselves explain why war began in 2014. The immediate causes were concrete military developments: local separatists seized administrative buildings, internal-security facilities, and military sites and proclaimed two republics; Ukraine deployed forces to restore its existing borders and central control; and Russia supplied weapons, cross-border formations, and border-based fire support to preserve the armed presence. Moscow described parts of its action as protection of Russian-speaking inhabitants of Ukraine and as prevention of further escalation, but after regular Russian troops entered Donbas, Russian activity went beyond the provision of weapons or advisers to informal local forces. Ukraine was not merely waiting for negotiations. Its forces blockaded towns, attacked the airport, and advanced toward the border, while separatists attacked border and transport routes in ways that forced Ukrainian units to disperse. The September Minsk arrangements attempted to reduce military intensity through ceasefires, negotiations, and incomplete provisions for local political reform. They did not resolve the core disputes over the legal status of cross-border forces, withdrawal of weapons, control of borders, or the distribution of local political authority.
impact: 軍事影響首先出現在控制區，而不在一場可以明確判定勝方的城市決戰。烏方在斯洛維揚斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、阿里季夫斯克、 Druzhkivka 及科斯季揚蒂夫斯克等北部城鎮保持控制，卻未能重新建立對頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克兩市的完整外廓。分離武裝則在頓涅茨克南部的邊境三角形建立縱深，並保有兩市中心、頓涅茨克機場區及魯甘斯克大片區域。這使最初被烏方視為短程平亂的行動逐漸轉化為持續數月的地面戰。烏克蘭把國民兵、志願營、邊境部隊與常備旅納入同一作戰體系，總參謀部與地方指揮部的協調、戰車回收、彈藥前送及工程保障成為比單個營能否奪取街區更關鍵的問題。俄羅斯則把原本臨近邊界的南方軍區部隊、第8合成陸軍集團及後方補給節點連成較穩定的支援結構，使地方武裝能獲得成建制裝甲與砲火，而不是只依賴小型突擊隊。雙方都更重視分散陣地、偽裝、機動砲兵、反裝甲伏擊、空中觀察及戰術偵察；但密集砲火和反砲火未能解決後勤及戰術指揮問題。戰役造成大量裝甲車、步兵車、迫擊砲與火炮損失，沒有一方的宣稱能提供可靠的總數。純軍事而言，二〇一四年最重要的制度結果是烏克蘭建立反恐怖主義作戰架構，俄羅斯把邊境部隊與地方武裝作戰合併編排，而前線也由鬆散零星戰鬥逐漸凝固成一條仍可再發動攻勢的分界線。
impactEn: The principal military effects were changes in territory rather than the outcome of a single urban battle. Ukraine retained Sloviansk, Kramatorsk, Artemivsk, Druzhkivka, Kostiantynivka, and other northern towns, but failed to establish a continuous perimeter around Donetsk or Luhansk. Separatist forces obtained depth in the southern Donetsk border triangle and retained the centers of both cities, the Donetsk Airport area, and substantial parts of Luhansk. An operation initially treated as a short internal-security campaign consequently developed into months of conventional ground warfare. Ukraine incorporated National Guard formations, volunteer battalions, border troops, and regular brigades into a common operational structure, exposing the importance of command coordination, armored-vehicle recovery, ammunition distribution, and engineering support. Russia connected formations of the Southern Military District, the 8th Combined Arms Army, and rear-area supply nodes to the front, allowing local forces to receive brigade-sized armor and artillery support rather than relying only on small raiding teams. Both sides placed greater emphasis on dispersed positions, concealment, mobile artillery, anti-ambush measures, aerial observation, and tactical reconnaissance. Heavy bombardment and counterbattery action did not solve the underlying logistical and command problems. Large numbers of tanks, armored personnel carriers, mortars, and artillery pieces were lost on both sides, but neither side’s claim can be treated as a reliable total. In strictly military terms, the most important institutional results of 2014 were Ukraine’s creation of an Anti-Terrorist Operation structure and Russia’s integration of border formations with operations conducted by local armed units. The front hardened into a ceasefire line that could support renewed offensives.
result: 截至二零一四年十二月三十一日，烏克蘭保住了斯洛維揚斯克至魯甘斯克北部的大部分鐵路與公路走廊，也繼續控制阿里季夫斯克、克拉馬托爾斯克、斯洛維揚斯克、北部魯甘斯克若干據點及德巴爾切韋；它仍未能奪回頓涅茨克和盧甘斯克市中心，也失去伊洛瓦伊斯克至俄羅斯邊境的主要突出地帶。頓涅茨克人民共和國控制頓涅茨克市、機場、頓涅茨克南部及邊境三角形，盧甘斯克人民共和國控制盧甘斯克市及省內大片西部、東部區域。雙方實際分界線呈多段折線，並非一條連續而清楚的陣地；德巴爾切韋突出部尤其沒有達成正式劃界。九月五日明斯克協議、九月十九日補充停火和十月大規模換俘，使大規模正面進攻明顯減少，但協議沒有一致落實的撤軍、全面非軍事化或可靠監察方案。十二月的零星砲擊和陣地行動仍在繼續，因此不能把年終狀態稱為永久和平。二〇一四年的戰役結果是雙方都保住部分目標、失去部分目標，並留下德巴爾切韋等仍可爭奪的地帶；它既不是烏方收復兩個州，也不是分離武裝推翻烏克蘭政府。戰爭未在十二月結束，後續戰鬥已超出本篇界定的年度範圍。
resultEn: By December 31, 2014, Ukraine had preserved much of the railway and road corridor through Sloviansk and northern Luhansk and continued to hold Artemivsk, Kramatorsk, several positions in northern Luhansk, and Debaltseve. It had not retaken the centers of Donetsk or Luhansk and had lost the principal salient around Ilovaisk leading toward the Russian border. The Donetsk Republic controlled Donetsk city, the airport, southern Donetsk, and the border triangle, while the Luhansk Republic held Luhansk city and substantial western and eastern portions of the oblast. The actual line of contact consisted of several angular sectors rather than one continuous and clearly defined front, and the Debaltseve salient was never formally delimited. The Minsk agreement of September 5, the additional ceasefire arrangements of September 19, and the large prisoner exchange in October reduced major conventional offensives, but no settlement with consistently implemented withdrawal, comprehensive demilitarization, or reliable verification was completed. Sporadic artillery fire and local positional fighting continued in December, so the year-end position cannot be described as a permanent peace. The military result of 2014 was that both sides retained some objectives, lost others, and left areas such as Debaltseve open to further contest. It was neither a Ukrainian recapture of the two oblasts nor a separatist overthrow of the Ukrainian government. The fighting did not end in December, and subsequent combat falls outside the annual scope of this account.
